title: The Whole Satchel
prompt: One last pack, cold, with the Quartermaster watching. Call it at every move.

steps.note: append puts it at the end. Four slots now.
-1 always means the last slot, however long the satchel is. No counting required.
And the front is 0 — not 1. Every satchel starts counting at zero.

config.success: Zero to the end and back again. That is the whole satchel, and it is yours.
